title: The Fractured Loom Hall

features.name: fractured loom
features.desc-on-touch: A loom in the process of learning separation. The frame is still whole, but the cloth—what there is of it—divides into independent sections. Each part remembers the pattern. None of it is thread anymore.

features.name: unweaving thread pool
features.desc-on-touch: Threads pooling at the base like water. They're not tangled—they're organized by the pattern they're learning to forget. Each one knows where it's going: back to being itself.

features.name: knot records
features.desc-on-touch: Hanging cards showing the knots as they were. Each card a threshold: the knot remembers being thread, learns to become two separate things remembering a single moment.

features.name: weaver's absence
features.desc-on-touch: The space where hands were. The loom fractured because no one was holding it together. Separation wasn't destruction—it was permission.

features.name: pattern-memory ground
features.desc-on-touch: The earth beneath the loom is braided with the ghost-pattern. The ground has learned what the loom was teaching. It remembers in color and grain.

inscription: the fractured loom is learning that separation is another word for honesty

file.name: Loom_Pattern_Decay_Study_Ochre_Field.txt
file.note: Before and after diagrams of the textile. The 'after' has more colors than the 'before'. The notes say: how does breaking teach?
